scope: deterministic character preset loadout skill-name reconciliation against canonical skills.json
methodology: Compared every skill-slot string in the 25 currently verified preset loadouts against canonical skill record names using exact case-insensitive identity matching. A normalized punctuation/spacing pass was also tested for unmatched entries and produced no additional matches. No alias, character-only, or historical identity was inferred.
interpretation: The verified preset layer contains 45 skill-slot references whose exact identities are not represented in the 475-record canonical skills corpus. This is a deterministic coverage gap, not evidence that the preset references are incorrect. The canonical corpus remains authoritative; no records were synthesized or promoted from preset data.
next: Research the 18 unmatched names against primary/current skill evidence and determine whether each should become a canonical cast-only/unavailable-for-CaC skill record, map to an existing canonical identity, or remain outside the canonical skill corpus. Preserve evidence and historical boundaries.
